svg.title: Most Used Languages
svg.desc: Most used languages across public non-fork repositories, each repository weighted equally: Python 25.7%, HTML 12.2%, JavaScript 11.7%, C 7.9%, Rust 6.8%, Dart 6.5%, C++ 6.1%, TypeScript 4.4%, Java 4.2%, Other 14.6%.
